banner: Synthetic demonstration. The interactive physiological signals shown here are generated data created to demonstrate the software architecture. They are not participant recordings and are not derived from the private multimodal research session. Experimental findings are presented separately as aggregate results.
rgb_disclaimer: Synthetic RGB demonstration. Generic channel modulation is used to exercise the rPPG processing and renderer. This is not a validated skin, camera or optical forward model.

synthetic_session.title: Synthetic session · Recovery 1

rgb_channel_means.normalisation: Synthetic display-model channels; each may be viewed relative to its own take mean.

claims: Every trace in this panel is generated; none is a participant recording.
RGB values are a generic channel-modulation display model, not a validated skin, camera or optical model.
The estimator rates are the repository's real CHROM/POS/Y code applied to the synthetic RGB traces.
Acoustic features come from a synthetic heart-sound envelope.

forecast_comparison.timesfm_status: TimesFM-3 run offline on the synthetic 30 s context (30 one-second samples only); the held-out synthetic future was not passed to it.

candidate_family.baseline: StandardMale baseline parameterization; no participant-specific modifiers

mechanistic_projection.label: Pulse HR-constrained projection for the synthetic scenario; not an individualized state estimate

model_episode.title: Pulse / OpenBF model episode
model_episode.time_basis: one simulated cardiac-cycle phase; separate from the real session
model_episode.optical_forward_model_status: A validated vascular-to-cutaneous observation model is not part of this episode. No synthetic rPPG is claimed.

research_results.note: These findings come from the private research session and are reported as aggregates only. They were not computed from the synthetic traces on this page and contain no participant recordings.

provenance.time_handling: Synthetic times in seconds from the synthetic take start; the model cycle uses its own phase coordinate.
provenance.forecast_model: TimesFM-3, run offline on synthetic input
provenance.mechanistic_engine: Pulse 4.3.2 (frozen StandardMale baseline), run offline; OpenBF outputs in the separate model-cycle example
